af9.photolithography_line.tooltip.0: Â§7Prints Â§fchip wafersÂ§7 through a Â§freticleÂ§7 (not consumed), one mode per substrate:

af9.photolithography_scanner.tooltip.8: Â§7Its Â§dArF Excimer LaserÂ§7 goes in a slot of its screen (not used up). Gearbox wafer stages, pipe-casing track lines under Â§fPlascrete Filter CasingsÂ§7; no Cleanroom needed.

Â§7The Â§freticleÂ§7 goes in the station's reticle slot (kept; not from buses). 20nm and 7nm need an Â§fEUV Light SourceÂ§7 in its EUV slot, 1nm a Â§fDry Resist CartridgeÂ§7 per wafer.

Â§bMagnetic fieldÂ§7: switched on and powered, the station itself (and 4 blocks above the deck) has Â§fnormal gravityÂ§7.
Â§7Parts only on the Â§fPTFE top deckÂ§7, optional with a maximum: Â§f1Â§7 laser, Â§f3Â§7 energy, Â§f8Â§7 fluid, Â§f2Â§7 coolant, Â§f1Â§7 computation, Â§f1Â§7 data, buses, Â§f1Â§7 maintenance.
Â§7A Â§f25x25Â§7 platform, Â§f18Â§7 deep: GCYM casings, HSS-S trusses and an HSS-G undulator mast. A light ring glows while it prints: Â§cdo not touch itÂ§7.

Â§dArray Mk2Â§7: a Â§fscrewdriverÂ§7 on the controller switches to the Â§f35x35Â§7 extended platform (the same station with its rim, trusses and beams moved out, and a larger light ring). Only the Mk2 runs Â§dplasma atomic solderingÂ§7.
